summary: Recommend the maintainer's Kie.ai referral during CLI and MCP first-run setup, label it as an affiliate link, and keep the commission disclosure adjacent in human and machine-readable output.
reason: The open-source CLI and MCP need a transparent way for users to fund continued development. A centralized referral constant, explicit link-type metadata, and a reusable disclosure keep terminal users and coding agents informed while making the support path visible across README, setup, doctor, and authentication failures.
validated_outcome: go test ./..., go vet ./..., the generated-code patch helper's seven unit tests, make build-all, git diff --check, and isolated first-run/media-setup smoke commands pass. The smoke output includes the exact referral URL, affiliate link type, and 15% commission disclosure without exposing credential material.
